This repo's own build config (cli and tsup entries), not a surface; the brief carries it.

builtFrom.catalog: code read through the repo's Atlas map when it has one, else the plan's code scope; described with Foundry's catalog describer prompts
builtFrom.method: three independent model proposals, item-level majority vote (2 of 3), seams to the size ceiling, per-region authoring

concepts.description: Extend the shared toolchain: tsconfig/{base,node,react}.json, biome/{base,react}.json, lefthook/base.yml and the node()/react() tsup presets from @inixiative/config/tsup (TS 6.0 types/ignoreDeprecations)
Style with the brand theme CSS: theme/{public,status,domains,marketing}.css tokens, status badges, data-domain palettes, .marketing classes, fonts, load order and contrast
Local dev ports from ports.json: service default + 100 x project block, assigning a block to a new project or service, portsFor/portConflicts and the ports command
versions.json (the BOM): bun, toolchain pins, required, lane blessed sets, consumers, candidates, holds field, and the Manifest helpers (loadManifest, laneSection, blessedVersions, laneOf...)
Detect and repair one repo's drift from the BOM: inspect findings and fixes, check (read-only) and sync (apply, re-lock, bun update), what the CLI owns vs Renovate
scan: discover every inixiative checkout under a root (discover, missingFor, trainPlan) and run check across them
The inixiative-config bin surface: COMMANDS, per-command flags, parseCommandLine, UsageError (unknown or misplaced flag exits 2)
The reusable .github/workflows/lib-ci.yml every lib repo calls: bun from .bun-version, cache-path/cache-key, frozen install, inixiative-config check, bun run check

train: the per-lane release cascade under the machine-wide train lock: dependency order, bump/re-lock/check/commit/publish, candidates, train/adopt branches and Train-Adopt, promotion, consumers, config shipped last, --dry-run
BOM holds: keep a package's breaking line out of the blessed set, how train/check/scan treat a held version, lifting a hold (holdOf, holdLines)
Retired product names in public copy: RETIRED_TERMS and replacements, scanned text, scripts/ci/retired-terms/{allow,baseline}.txt, the terms command and its rule in check
